frequency_question: How often do central government industrial subsidy schemes complete the full drafting-to-gazette pipeline within 280 days?
membership_rule: Members are major multi-sector industrial or transport financial incentive policies initiated by central ministries requiring inter-ministerial consultation and cabinet-level approval; excluded are minor amendments or emergency relief packages.
coverage_note: 5 named major schemes; representative of standard central ministry policy turnaround times under normal administrative capacity.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-schemes handled purely at joint-secretary level without cabinet consultation.
skeleton: Total major industrial schemes identified in the past decade versus those successfully gazetted within 9 months of initial public announcement.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 observed major framework rollouts within the timeframe.
validity_reason: Administrative procedures and bureaucratic processing timelines for central ministries remain stable over medium-term legislative cycles.
